title: Experiment for: Reducing Safety Margin
rationale: Candidate task.policy.safety_margin=0.1: Expected Improvement=0.50, Info Gain=1.00, Prior Influence=No direct prior bias. Mechanism: The safety margin is a buffer zone that the robot maintains to avoid obstacles. Decreasing this margin can make the robot more aggressive in its path planning.
expected_outcome: Reducing the safety margin will encourage the robot to take more direct paths to the goal, potentially reducing the number of collisions by allowing it to come closer to obstacles.
